about_the_game:
About This Game

Find 100 cats lost in a colorful circus and bring this crazy escape to life by coloring them by numbers!

Hand-drawn circus tents, jugglers, tightropes, circus animals, and mysterious backstage areas await you. Can you find the cute cats hidden everywhere?

🎨 After finding them, color the scenes only by numbers. Invite a friend and enjoy this fun escape adventure together!

✨ Features:

🎪 Hand-drawn circus environment: Colorful tents, costumes, and stage magic

🐱 100 hidden cats: A crazy escape filled with different numbers

🎨 Paint by numbers: A relaxing painting experience by following only the numbers

🧘‍♀️ Stress-free gameplay

🎧 Circus-themed fun radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play duo with a friend
